setup: for env_file in .env apps/api/.env apps/web/.env apps/admin/.env apps/space/.env apps/live/.env; do if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then if [ -f "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/$env_file" ]; then cp "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/$env_file" "$env_file"; else cp "$env_file.example" "$env_file"; fi; fi; done

backend.command: docker compose -p plane -f docker-compose-local.yml -f docker-compose-local.ports.yml up --build

api-tests.command: docker compose -f docker-compose-test.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from api-tests; status=$?; docker compose -f docker-compose-test.yml down -v; exit $status
